name: Chained brute
description: a brimstone demon of the Cracked Road: a hunched body of cracked black basalt with molten orange light glowing through every seam, short curved horns of charred stone, small burning ember eyes, a wide jaw with a furnace glow inside, big and broad, armoured in riveted black iron plates on its front, an iron shackle on one wrist with a thick chain hanging from it

poses.stand: standing broad and square, the armoured front facing forward, the chain hanging from its shackled wrist
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

move.action: stomps forward heavily, chain swinging from its wrist, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: opens its furnace jaw and spits one small slow glowing ember forward to the right, a little puff of smoke

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
